description: Bhavya Foundation — Photography asset manifest. Some documentary JPEGs are now present under the same basenames; full provenance lives in assets/manifest.json. Interim .svg scene files remain on disk but must not ship as imagery and are not referenced by application code.

asset_policy.current: WIRED — real documentary JPEGs present and wired for hero, why-terrace-garhwal, heritage-stone-temple, knowledge-books-notepad, community-village-landscape, and forest-cedar-sunlight. knowledge-school-children, heritage-wooden-temple, and community-village-gathering remain ASSET REQUIRED (do not pass PHOTO_PENDING keys as photo props).
asset_policy.target: real documentary JPEG photographs from the Himalayan region (prefer Himachal Pradesh; Uttarakhand acceptable when labeled honestly)
asset_policy.swap_rule: Place real .jpg with same basename (2400x1600, 3:2, JPEG sRGB) and wire PHOTO map / HeroBackground photo props / feature-panel img slots. Never ship broken images (naturalWidth 0), SVG content with .jpg extension, or fake MIME.
asset_policy.quality_blocker: Do not restore or ship SVG content disguised as .jpg (historical commit cea919c stored SVG bytes under .jpg names).
asset_policy.legal_notice: Contextual real photographs do not imply Bhavya Foundation activities unless verified by repository evidence. Use language like 'Across the Himalayan communities we seek to serve' or 'Representative photograph — Himachal Pradesh / Uttarakhand.'
